source.title: 3D Models of the Visible Human Male and Female Lower Extremities
source.scope: Female specimen; pelvis to ankle; muscle, bone, cartilage, ligament and fat geometries segmented from Visible Human cryosections.

currentAtlasCoverage.sourceIdentity: A second female specimen/reference; not the same individual as the main HuBMAP female organ/surface assembly.

knownGaps: This source does not provide a complete female muscle set for the trunk, upper limbs, neck or head.
Do not present generic or male-derived muscle geometry as female-specimen-specific.
Any future generic anatomical muscle layer must be clearly labelled as a separate illustrative reference and carry its own licence and provenance.
